terms.definition: Earned run average: earned runs allowed per nine innings. Lower is better.
Walks plus hits per inning pitched. Lower is better.
On-base plus slugging: how often a lineup reaches base plus how much power it hits for. Higher means a stronger lineup.
Share of plate appearances that end in a strikeout.
Share of plate appearances that end in a walk.
Total movement of the pitch, sideways and up or down, compared with a pitch thrown without spin.
The number of hitters a pitcher has pitched to.
How often hitters swing and miss against him.
How well a pitcher puts the ball where he wants it.
In this report, the pitch he uses second most (at least 15% of his pitches).
Too few pitches or batters faced for a reliable read; the packet says how many are needed.
